display_name: UIC voluntary motor vehicle insurance rules (AutoJoy; Decision 271/2018/UIC-QD): physical damage cover with its exclusions, settlement, deductible and reductions; accident cover of the persons carried; voluntary liability (declined)

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the source's text rendering by tools/vnsrc.py, and in short runs checked to occur verbatim in it (GLOSSARY.md, NOTES.md, COMPARABLES.md). The bilingual record is GLOSSARY.md.

documents.file_note: pdftotext -layout rendering of the PDF (source/fetch.sh); its own sha256 is dda0086b78ec87a7c13872e50ba7bfe8f8f9a225b0c076dc2c31a074763c46d2. src:N is line N of this file.
documents.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer on its own website; not law

aids.use: read only, for forks tagged LAW: in NOTES.md; not encoded; its text ends at Article 130

scope: The whole document. Encoded: Part 1 definitions 1, 5-10; the opening paragraph of Part II; Articles 1, 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9; the deadline-bearing duties of Articles 3.2, 4 and 5 as regulative rules; Article 10 (events insured, costs), Article 11 (18 exclusions), Article 12, Article 13 (repair or replace, the depreciation table, total loss, theft, salvage, the order of settlement), Article 14 (deductible, tiered table), Article 15 (reductions), Article 16, Part IV; Part 2 Articles 1-4. Inert (quoted, with reasons): the title and contents, definitions 2-4, rights lists and duties with no time or consequence, Art 6.3, Art 13.4.6, the definition of one loss, Part 2 Art 5, page footers. Out of scope: Art 4.2.8 and 5.2.11 (other duties under law at large). Reached and refused: Part 3, whose rules are Circular 04/2021/TT-BTC, not in the sources. Declined by name where the document does not answer: a vehicle kind definition 5 does not name; an exclusion lifted by a supplementary clause (whose terms are not in the document); a rate left to UIC and not supplied; Art 4.2.3 without the authority's conclusion; Part 2 Art 4.2(b) for a person with no workplace; a Part 2 accident abroad under another agreement. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run (the row was briefed as one session with no sub-agents). Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules, worked by hand from the source before the assertion was run.

forks.F1: Art 10.1: 'bat ngo, khong luong truoc duoc' qualifies the accident only; a natural disaster need not be unforeseeable.
forks.F2: Art 10.1.4: theft of the whole car is not read through the chapeau.
forks.F3: Definition 5: a vehicle kind named on neither side of the open list is declined by name.
forks.F4: Definition 7: time in use counts whole months elapsed.
forks.F5: Art 2: default cover from 00:01 to 23:59 inclusive, by the minute.
forks.F6: Art 3.1 / 16.1: cover ends from the day after a missed due date.
forks.F7: Art 3.2: a notice of fewer than 7 days takes effect 7 days after it is given.
forks.F8: Art 3 and 4.2.7: premium for the time remaining is pro rata by calendar days, both end days counted.
forks.F9: Art 6.2: any difference in the independent assessor's conclusion makes UIC pay for it.
forks.F10: Art 9.1: one year is the same calendar date a year later, plus obstacle days.
forks.F11: Every period in days is in calendar days.
forks.F12: Day 0 is the day of the triggering event; a duty within n days is met on day n.
forks.F13: Art 11.12: only labels fitted by the manufacturer are saved; tyres and the cargo body are excluded whatever the cause.
forks.F14: Art 11.15: 'may moc' is read as electrical machinery.
forks.F15: Art 11.16 / 15.1.4: a vehicle carrying goods and persons is measured by the greater overload.
forks.F16: Art 10.2 costs are paid beside the indemnity, outside the Art 13.4 steps and the Art 12.1 cap.
forks.F18: 'gia tri thuc te' is the market value at conclusion; at or above it the insured proportion is 1.
forks.F19: The depreciation table's age is definition 7's time in use.
forks.F20: Depreciation applies to an under-insured vehicle too (Art 13.4.2).
forks.F21: The 75% repair-cost test counts covered parts only.
forks.F22: The wreck deduction applies only when the policyholder keeps the wreck, at UIC's valuation times the insured proportion.
forks.F23: The tiered deductible counts losses within the insurance period.
forks.F24: Art 15.1.1.4: '2 duties above' is any two of the three.
forks.F25: Art 15.1.3: any rate from 0 to 100% set by UIC.
forks.F26: Art 15.1.5: the premium paid is the premium charged on the policy.
forks.F27: Part 2: 'xe co gioi' is the insured car.
forks.F28: Part 2 Art 2: 'while in traffic' qualifies being on the vehicle and getting on or off.
forks.F29: Part 2: the sum insured is per person; the payout table's rate is a percentage of it.
forks.F30: Part 2 Art 4.5: applied by the percentage for a healthy person properly treated.
forks.F31: Part 2 Art 3.5: 'va' between narcotics and stimulants is read as 'or'.
forks.F32: Part 2 Art 3.6: an expired or withdrawn licence is not excluded.
forks.F33: Part 2 Art 4.2(b): the 0,1% a day cap applies to the nutrition costs only.
forks.F34: Part 2 Art 4.4: a death after the contract term falls to Art 4.1 as written.
forks.F35: Art 2.2: a transfer on or before the day of the loss counts; without written approval nobody is covered.
forks.F36: Art 15.1.1.2: the force-majeure excuse needs UIC's confirmation.
forks.F37: A lifted exclusion leads to a named refusal; the depreciation waiver is applied as stated; the 11.13 and 11.14 clauses bring their events into Art 10.1.
forks.F39: Art 4.2.7: adjustment = (reassessed - charged premium) x days remaining / days in the period.
forks.F40: Part 2's premium condition is Part II's opening paragraph, the same test as Art 16.1.
forks.F41: Art 8 is followed as written, though Law 08/2022 Art 49.1 is narrower.
forks.F42: The encoding answers the Rules alone; a contract's own amending clauses are not modelled.
forks.F43: Art 16.2 set-off is at UIC's election; unpaid premium is the premium less what was paid.
forks.F44: A partial loss whose every part is excluded is not covered and earns no Art 10.2 costs.
